triage_hint_assessment: Triage's premise is factually wrong and should be discounted. It cited 'a history of blowing through implied moves (35.8% in Dec)'. The actual December 2025 reaction was +24.36% (computed from daily OHLC), and PATH has come in UNDER the implied move in 6 of its last 8 prints, with a median realised absolute move of 5.97% against implied moves of 12-15%. The 35.8% figure traces to an Investing.com summary whose per-quarter numbers do not reconcile with the price series. The dispersion is real but the option is expensive relative to the historical distribution; the likelier panel error here is over-forecasting magnitude, not under-forecasting it.
